findings.text: follow-on: the owns-target derivation excludes reckon/crew/promotion.py::_release_run_workspace, a removal path that still decides via the phase-gated claim at promotion.py:6141, so section 45's 'every path that removes or reclaims' is not literally enforced; the node names this in its manifest and fragment follow-on.
